dependencies.reason: Consumes toolio.Command, toolio.Run (Emit, Warn, Artifact, SetUsage), toolio.RunDir/OpenRunDir, *toolio.Failure with FixHint, and the envelope usage fields. cmd/af and internal/toolio do not exist until spec 05 is implemented.
The tool gate calls the ring-1 guard's Go decision function in internal/policy with HookConfig; the submit command reads stdin through Run.Stdin, which spec 06 adds.

tasks.title: Box registry, Open and Sync over the local provider
steps: Write the listed tests first (package box, real-git helper copied from internal/gitx newRepo(t), a counting provider wrapper and stub providers whose Create or Sync fails) and confirm they fail
Add (*gitx.Git).TopLevel(ctx) (string, error) running `rev-parse --show-toplevel` in internal/gitx/git.go (reuse one from spec 06 if it already exists)

Create internal/box/registry.go: a registry of providers by name with `local` registered (wrapping agentkit sandbox.Open("local"), kept behind one adapter file so unverified agentkit signatures stay in one place); Lookup of an unknown name returns a usage *toolio.Failure listing every registered name
Create internal/box/open.go with Request{Provider, HostDir, RunID, Tool, Env, TTL, Record, Warn} and Open(ctx, Request) (*Session, error)
In Open check HostDir is a work tree top level by comparing filepath.EvalSymlinks of HostDir and TopLevel; otherwise return a usage Failure naming the top level
Create the sandbox with Spec{Env, Labels{af.run_id, af.tool}, TTL}; a Create error is Failure failed/sandbox retryable false
Sync HostDir in with .git (sandbox.LocalDir); a Sync failure closes the sandbox first and returns Failure failed/sandbox retryable true
Record ledger entries box_open {provider} then box_sync {head} through Request.Record, head from gitx.Head
Raise warning box_unconfined once per Open (never on later Sync) when the provider is local, with a message saying the box has no process or network isolation
Create internal/box/session.go with Session, Provider(), Spec(), Tools() and Sync(ctx) (re-sync + box_sync record); never write the host checkout

Verify with real git that box HEAD (git rev-parse --short HEAD via Tools) equals host Head, and that commits and writes inside leave host HEAD, status and files unchanged; if the local provider works in place on the host dir, stop and report an erratum

tasks.title: Session FS, WriteFile, Export, Close and box.With
steps: Write the listed tests first (including a stub sandbox whose Export creates <dst>/.git and one whose Close errors) and confirm they fail

Add Session.FS(ctx) fs.FS in internal/box/fs.go: a read-only io/fs view built on the box's read and listing tools; a missing path maps to fs.ErrNotExist, a directory stats as a directory; implement Open, Stat, ReadFile and ReadDir
Add Session.WriteFile(ctx, rel, data): accept only fs.ValidPath paths under .agent-fox/, otherwise return a plain internal error (not a usage Failure); write through the box write tool

Add Session.Export(ctx): os.MkdirTemp(os.TempDir(), "af-export-<run_id>-*"), sandbox Export into it, and remove it plus return Failure failed/sandbox "export carried .git" if <dir>/.git exists; record box_export {path} and remember the dir
Make Close idempotent with sync.Once: close the sandbox once, remove all export directories, record box_close once, return nil on later calls
Create internal/box/with.go: With(ctx, req, fn) opens a session, runs fn, and closes via defer on every path including panic (recover, close, re-panic with the same value) and cancellation
Run the close on context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30*time.Second); a close error raises warning box_close_failed through req.Warn and never changes fn's result
Cover the cancellation case by cancelling the context inside fn and asserting close count equals create count with a counting provider wrapper

tasks.title: Submission kinds and the Submit core
steps: Write the listed tests first (package submission; a Target whose Tree is os.DirFS and Write writes the host filesystem) and confirm they fail

Create internal/submission/kind.go with Kind{Name, ToolName, Description, Schema, Validate}, Problem{Path, Message}, Refused{Problems} (implements error, message names every problem) and Receipt{Path, SHA256}
Create internal/submission/submit.go with Target{Tree fs.FS, Write func(ctx, rel string, data []byte) error, RunID} and Submit(ctx, target, kind, raw, now)
Refuse (without writing) a payload over 1 MiB, empty or whitespace-only, or not a single JSON object (arrays, bare strings, trailing second value); use json.Decoder and check for trailing data
Read .agent-fox/run/<id>/run.json from Tree; refuse with a Problem naming run.json when missing, unparsable or naming another kind
Call Kind.Validate; refuse with all returned problems; sort Problems by Path then Message (sort.SliceStable) for every refusal

On success compact the normalised payload, compute sha256 hex, build {kind, run_id, attempt, nonce, submitted_at, payload_sha256, payload} with attempt and nonce from run.json, and call Target.Write for .agent-fox/run/<id>/submission.json
Provide a host-filesystem Write helper that writes a temp file in the same directory and os.Rename's it over the target, leaving no temp file; a refusal never touches an existing file
Verify the last valid submission wins and Receipt.SHA256 matches payload_sha256 in the file

tasks.title: The submit command factory
steps: Write the listed tests first using a toolio.App with the command registered and a fake kind; confirm they fail (read internal/toolio for the real Command, Run, Failure and App names and adapt)
Create internal/submission/command.go with Command(path string, kind Kind) toolio.Command
Declare flags --dir (default .) and --run-id; open the run directory with toolio.OpenRunDir (missing or invalid id returns the usage Failure, exit 2)
Declare the command so it creates no run directory, does not opt into --dry-run, and carries a ResultSchema for {run_id, kind, path, sha256} so it shows in `af --schema`
Read the payload as raw JSON from Run.Stdin (added by spec 06)
Open the tree with os.OpenRoot(dir) and use root.FS() as Target.Tree so symlinks escaping the root cannot be read; Write goes through the root-confined filesystem helper from task 3
On success return status done with result {run_id, kind, path, sha256} and artifact {kind: submission, path}

On *Refused (including malformed JSON) return a Failure failed/submission retryable true whose message names every problem; the earlier file stays untouched; register category `submission` in toolio if absent
Test the symlink property with generated absolute, ../ and nested targets and assert the outside secret never appears in output

tasks.title: Brain contract types, shared flags and box environment
steps: Write the listed tests first (package brain) and confirm they fail

Create internal/brain/brain.go with Brain, Brief (Document() = Prefix+Task), Outcome, HookConfig (json tags run_id, protected_paths, allow_programs) and ToolCall exactly as in the PRD, with Brief.Box *box.Session and Kind submission.Kind

Create internal/brain/registry.go with Entry{Name, CostSource, BoxEnv, New func(Options) (Brain, error)}, Options{Model, Script, NewProvider, Getenv} and a Registry type with Register, Names and New(name, opts); an unknown name returns a usage Failure listing registered names (the default registry is populated by tasks 9 and 10)
Add BuildBoxEnv(entry, getenv) map[string]string returning exactly the host values of the BoxEnv names that are set and nothing else

Create internal/brain/flags.go: Flags(fs *flag.FlagSet, defaults) registering --brain, --sandbox, --budget, --max-turns, --script with caller-supplied defaults (sandbox default local) and a Validate method
Validate returns usage Failures naming the flag for: budget not finite or <= 0 (NaN, Inf, 0, negative), --max-turns < 1, --brain scripted without --script, --script with any other brain

Define the Report interface (Emit, Warn, Artifact, SetUsage) and Tally in internal/brain/report.go with an assertion `var _ Report = (*toolio.Run)(nil)`, adapting with a wrapper if the real signatures differ

tasks.title: Execute: place the brief, run the brain, record usage
steps: Write the listed tests first using a stub Brain, a local box session on a temp repo, a real RunDir and a recording Report; confirm they fail
Create internal/brain/execute.go with Request{Session, Name, Brain, Brief, RunDir, Report, Tally, Heartbeat, Rand}, Result{Outcome, Payload, Path} and Execute

Draw a 16-hex nonce from Request.Rand; write through Session.WriteFile .agent-fox/.gitignore (*), .agent-fox/run/<id>/brief.md (Document()), run.json {run_id, kind, attempt, nonce} and hook.json (HookConfig with .agent-fox/ added to ProtectedPaths when missing)
Write host copies <run_dir>/brief.<attempt>.md and <run_dir>/hook.json; record brief_placed {attempt, bytes, sha256, prefix_sha256}; set TranscriptPath to <run_dir>/transcript.<attempt>.jsonl
Set Brief.Observe to emit one tool_call event whose data holds only brain, tool, decision, reason, ok, duration_ms

Apply context.WithTimeout from the start of the run when Brief.Timeout > 0; emit step events brief, brain, submission in order; run a heartbeat ticker (default 30 s) emitting heartbeat {brain, elapsed_ms}
Record brain_start, call Brain.Run inside a recover wrapper, then record brain_end {brain, stop_reason, submitted_claim, cost_usd, cost_source, turns, duration_ms}
On panic write the stack to <run_dir>/brain-panic.<attempt>.txt and return Failure failed/brain; register categories brain, no_result, budget, sandbox in toolio if absent
Add the Outcome to Tally (also when Run errored) and call Report.SetUsage with the accumulated totals and brain = Request.Name
Leave a clearly separated function seam for the post-run submission decision implemented in task 7 (until then Execute returns a no_result Failure)

tasks.title: Execute: decide the submission and map failures
steps: Write the listed tests first with stub brains that write the box submission.json directly through Session.WriteFile or call submission.Submit; confirm they fail
After Brain.Run, read .agent-fox/run/<id>/submission.json through Session.FS using a fresh context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30s) when the run context has expired

Decide only from the file: parse; kind, run_id, attempt, nonce must match; payload_sha256 must match the compacted payload; Kind.Validate must accept the payload against Session.FS (the re-validated payload is authoritative)

On acceptance copy the file atomically (temp + rename) to <run_dir>/submission.json, add artifact {kind: submission, path}, record submission_accepted {sha256}, and return Result{Outcome, Payload, Path}

On parse, kind, run_id, attempt, sha or validation failure raise warning submission_invalid with its problems and record submission_invalid; on a different nonce record submission_stale; on a missing file record submission_absent; all count as no submission
Raise warning submission_claim_mismatch when Outcome.Submitted differs from the host's decision
Add artifact {kind: transcript, path} when a file exists at TranscriptPath, using os.Stat only, never reading it
A valid submission wins: a returned Run error becomes warning brain_error and Execute returns nil error

Without a submission fail in order: Brief.Timeout expired -> Failure timeout with FixHint --timeout twice the value; ctx cancelled or the caller's deadline passed -> return the context error; Run error -> failed/brain retryable true; StopReason budget -> failed/budget retryable false with FixHint --budget doubled; StopReason turns -> failed/budget with FixHint --max-turns doubled; else failed/no_result retryable true
Verify an Outcome with Submitted true and no valid file yields no Payload and nothing is parsed from the transcript

tasks.title: The tool gate for in-process brains
steps: Write the listed tests first with a spy box tool set and a transcript writer; confirm they fail
Read the real ring-1 guard API in internal/policy (spec 06) and the real box tool types from the agentkit adapter in internal/box; adapt the signatures below to them

Create internal/brain/gate.go with a Gate built from Brief (Tools allowlist, Hook, Observe, brain name), the box tool set and a transcript writer; Gate.Call(ctx, tool, args) returns a result or an error-result
Deny a tool not in Brief.Tools with exactly "tool <name> is not in this run's allowlist" without invoking it; the terminating submit tool bypasses the allowlist (the brains wire it in)
Pass each allowed call with Brief.Hook to the guard's Go decision function and execute only on allow; return the guard's reason as the error result on deny

Deny any write_file whose cleaned path resolves under .agent-fox/ (including ./sub/../.agent-fox/x) and any execute command that redirects or writes to .agent-fox/, via the guard's ProtectedPaths or an in-gate check; the message names the protected path

For every decided call invoke Observe once with ToolCall{Brain, Tool, Decision, Reason, OK, DurationMS} and append one JSON line {seq, tool, args, decision, reason, ok, result} with strictly increasing seq and args/result each truncated to 4096 bytes (UTF-8 safe)
Expose a helper to validate Brief.Tools names against the box tool set returning an internal error naming the unknown tool, used by both brains at Run start

tasks.title: The scripted brain
steps: Write the listed tests first with script files in t.TempDir() and a local session; confirm they fail

Create internal/brain/scripted.go: parse the --script file with json.Decoder.DisallowUnknownFields into {steps: [...]}; each step is exactly one of {tool, args} or {submit}, with optional expect (ok|error|denied for tool, accepted|refused for submit)
Construction failures (unreadable file, unknown field, both or neither form, invalid expect) are usage Failures naming the file and step index, raised in the registry New before any box opens
Register the `scripted` entry (CostSource none, BoxEnv empty) in the default registry

Run: validate Brief.Tools against the box tools first (internal error, no step run), then replay steps in order on the host; tool steps go through the gate over Brief.Box.Tools(), submit steps through submission.Submit with Tree = Session.FS and Write = Session.WriteFile
Treat each step as one turn; compare the actual result (ok, error, denied or accepted, refused) to expect and on mismatch stop and return an error naming the step index, expected and actual

An accepted submit ends the replay with Outcome{Submitted true, StopReason submitted} and lists remaining steps as skipped in the transcript; reaching MaxTurns gives StopReason turns with Turns = MaxTurns; running out of steps gives ended
Report CostUSD 0, CostSource none, Turns = steps run and write the transcript to Brief.TranscriptPath, setting Outcome.Transcript

tasks.title: The agentkit brain on the host over box tools
steps: Write the listed tests first using agentkit's provider/faux (recording requests) and local sessions; confirm they fail

Read what agentkit-go exposes (module is replaced by ../agentkit-go and may be unreadable): if signatures differ from the PRD's assumed agentkit.New, Config.Prefix, MaxCostUSD, BeforeToolCall and faux, adapt in one adapter file internal/brain/agentkit_adapter.go and record the differences in the task notes
Create internal/brain/agentkit.go and register the `agentkit` entry (CostSource measured, BoxEnv empty) in the default registry so Lookup of an unknown name lists agentkit and scripted

Constructor: use Options.NewProvider when set; otherwise build agentkit's provider for Options.Model and, when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing from Options.Getenv, return Failure failed/auth with FixHint {Env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY} before any box opens (register category auth if absent)

Run: validate Brief.Tools against box tools first (internal error before any model call); build the driver with agentkit.New with Prefix = Brief.Prefix, the allowlisted box tools plus a terminating tool named Kind.ToolName with Kind.Description and Kind.Schema, MaxCostUSD, MaxTurns and the task 8 gate as BeforeToolCall; send Brief.Task as the first user message

Terminating tool calls submission.Submit against the session; a *Refused returns every problem as the tool's error result and the loop continues; an acceptance ends the loop through the driver's terminating-tool mechanism or by cancelling the driver's context, giving StopReason submitted
Keep the submit tool available with an empty Brief.Tools; denied calls return the reason as the tool error result so it is the next faux request's content
Map the driver's stop to budget, turns or ended, and take cost, turns and tokens from the driver with CostSource measured; write the transcript via the gate's writer
Add a test helper that builds a Brief and box env for the agentkit and scripted entries with host tokens set (TS-07-9) and asserts Session.Spec().Env and Brief.Env are empty
done_when: `go test ./internal/brain/... -count=1` passes offline with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset

tasks.title: Brain contract tests, offline guarantee and documentation
steps: Write internal/brain/contract_test.go as a table with rows scripted (script file) and agentkit (faux script); both run the same brief over a local box on a temp repo with a test kind whose validator checks a cited path exists in the tree

Each script calls a tool outside the allowlist, writes under .agent-fox/, submits an invalid payload citing a missing path, then submits the valid one; assert identical normalised payload bytes in <run_dir>/submission.json, denials not executed, problems reached the brain as its next turn, Outcome.Submitted true, cost_source none vs measured
Add the property test TS-07-78 with generated valid payloads (keys, nested values, unicode, whitespace) across both brains
Add TS-07-79: unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, replace http.DefaultTransport with one failing non-loopback dials, run both brains offline and assert zero dial attempts
Run `make doc` first (it generates nothing for internal packages, but steering requires it)

Update docs/architecture.md: The brain interface as built (differing fields, registry, submission file with nonce), run-dir layout additions (brief.<attempt>.md, hook.json, submission.json, transcript.<attempt>.jsonl, box-side run.json, ledger kinds), and mark agentkit placement host-side in this release

Update docs/cli.md: categories sandbox, brain, no_result, budget, submission; warnings box_unconfined, box_close_failed, submission_invalid, submission_claim_mismatch, brain_error; the shared brain and box flags and the submit command contract
Update docs/configuration.md and docs/model-usage.md: AF_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, cost measured vs reported per brain, and that local is unconfined

Create or update docs/development.md with the scripted brain's script format and how to write a faux-driven test; add internal/brain/, internal/box/ and internal/submission/ to README.md's What is here table
Run `make check` and fix any failures

steps: Write the five smoke tests TS-07-80..84 against real components (real local provider, real git, real RunDir, real toolio.App for the submit command, faux provider for agentkit) and confirm they pass

Trace 07-PATH-1 through the real code: brain.Flags -> registry New(scripted) -> box.With -> box.Open -> brain.Execute -> scripted brain -> submission.Submit -> Execute decision -> box close; confirm each step calls the next and no stub remains

Trace 07-PATH-2 (agentkit on faux with a denied tool and a refused submission), 07-PATH-3 (submit command), 07-PATH-4 (stale submission, failed/no_result, usage still recorded, box closed) and 07-PATH-5 (export without .git, removed on Close)

For every criterion with a contract confirm the producer's result is consumed in production code: Result.Payload and Path, Outcome via Tally and SetUsage, box_unconfined and box_close_failed warnings, submission.Command registered by a caller, the registry and Flags used by a command

Search internal/brain, internal/box, internal/submission and internal/gitx for panic("not implemented"), TODO, and a bare `return nil` on a non-trivial path, and remove any that remain
